install.why1: Opens straight from its icon on your home screen
install.why3: Everything you save stays safely on your device
install.dismissed: Not installed. You can install it later with the steps below.
install.doneText: You are using the ตังค์ไปไหน app from your home screen.
install.justText: Open the ตังค์ไปไหน app from its icon on your home screen.
install.stepsHeadingOr: Or install it with these steps
install.ios1: Open the ตังค์ไปไหน app in Safari
install.ios2: Tap Share (if you can’t find it, tap ⋯ first)
install.ios3: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”
install.ios4: Tap “Add”: the ตังค์ไปไหน app appears on your home screen
install.iosNote: Chrome on iPhone works too: Share is at the right of the address bar at the top.
install.android1: Open the ตังค์ไปไหน app in Chrome
install.android3: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
install.android4: Tap “Install”: the ตังค์ไปไหน app appears on your home screen
install.androidNote: Samsung Internet works too: tap ☰, then “Add page to” → “Home screen”.
